bio: Latticework and white plaster walls exude a machiya feel. The ambience is charming at night, with light seeping in to add warmth to the stillness. This entire district, today known as Naramachi, was once the precinct of Gangoji Temple; the restaurant is on the former site of the main temple building. Two sisters run the eatery, the younger preparing sushi, and the elder handling service. Sharing an unspoken understanding, they move in quiet harmony, and diners naturally fall into the rhythm between them....
